security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Chinese prose, Markdown code fences, DOCX XML, and vendor documentation. Real risk remains in bundled setup and document-generation tooling that can run shell commands, invoke external programs, install packages with sudo, and persist environment changes. Static review was capped at 400/1023 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 623 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Bundled setup scripts can install system packages with sudo.
remediation.suggestion: Do not run dependency installation automatically. Require explicit user approval and document exact package-manager commands before execution.

remediation.issue: Setup scripts can modify user shell configuration and home-directory tool paths.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer project-local setup instructions or temporary environment variables instead of appending to shell startup files.

remediation.issue: DOCX generation invokes external programs such as pandoc and shell-based environment checks.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command arguments fixed, avoid shell=True, and surface each external command for user confirmation in marketplace installs.

remediation.issue: The static review was capped and many lower-priority matches were not adjudicated individually.
remediation.suggestion: Run a full manual review of the bundled vendor toolkit before allowing automatic marketplace installation.

content.value_statement: Software copyright filings require consistent code, manual, and application materials. This skill guides Claude Code, Claude, or Codex through evidence-based Chinese filing drafts and final Word or TXT outputs.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes an imported project to identify source files, routes, pages, dependencies, and likely software metadata.
Generates Chinese Markdown drafts for business understanding, application information, code materials, and an operation manual.
Requires user confirmation at key stages before creating final filing materials.
Extracts code materials from confirmed source files and keeps a traceable extraction manifest.
Builds final Word and TXT materials using bundled DOCX tooling or a fallback generator.
Supports screenshot planning, user-supplied screenshots, or visible screenshot placeholders when screenshots are skipped.
limitations: The generated materials are not legal advice and still require human review before submission.
The workflow is designed for Chinese software copyright materials and Chinese-language filing conventions.
Full DOCX generation may require local tools such as .NET, pandoc, or LibreOffice.
Project understanding depends on the available source code, documentation, and user-provided business context.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first filing package
use_cases.description: Generate draft application text, code materials, and an operation manual from a real project before formal review.

use_cases.title: Standardize client deliverables
use_cases.description: Create consistent Chinese software copyright materials for multiple customer projects with confirmation gates.

use_cases.title: Review project evidence before submission
use_cases.description: Trace selected code files, software names, version data, and manual content before generating final Word files.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic filing workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a project already placed in the current directory.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the software-copyright-materials skill to analyze this project and start generating Chinese software copyright application materials. Stop at each required confirmation step.

prompt_templates.title: Generate drafts for review
prompt_templates.scenario: Create editable Markdown before final Word files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the project, build the business understanding evidence, and generate Markdown drafts for application information, code materials, and the operation manual. Do not create final Word files until I confirm the drafts.

prompt_templates.title: Control code material selection
prompt_templates.scenario: Select only representative source code for the filing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the code file candidate list for software copyright materials. Recommend files and line ranges that best show the real product functions, then wait for my confirmation before extraction.

prompt_templates.title: Complete final materials with constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Proceed after all user gates are confirmed.
prompt_templates.prompt: After confirming the business context, application fields, code selection, screenshot method, and Markdown drafts, generate final Word and TXT materials. Keep the software name and version consistent with the confirmed application information.

output_examples.input: Generate software copyright materials for a React management system.
output_examples.output: The workflow creates environment checks, project analysis, business understanding drafts, application information, code extraction materials, and a Chinese operation manual for review.

output_examples.input: I want to skip screenshots for now.
output_examples.output: The skill records the screenshot choice, keeps visible screenshot placeholders in the manual, and continues with text-based final materials after confirmation.

output_examples.input: Use only selected frontend files for the code document.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a candidate list, asks for confirmation, then extracts only approved files or line ranges into traceable code materials.

best_practices: Review every Markdown draft before allowing final Word or TXT generation.
Confirm the software full name and version once, then use the same values across all final materials.
Provide clear business context and screenshots when the source code does not explain the product workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not submit generated materials without legal, business, and technical review.
Do not let the workflow invent product functions that are not supported by project evidence.
Do not run bundled setup scripts without understanding their package installation and shell changes.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It prepares draft materials and document outputs, but users should review them with qualified professionals before submission.

faq.question: Can it create code materials from any project?
faq.answer: It works best when the project source code and key documentation are available in the current workspace.

faq.question: Does it require screenshots?
faq.answer: No. Users can choose automated screenshots, user-supplied screenshots, or visible placeholders when screenshots are skipped.

faq.question: Why are confirmation steps required?
faq.answer: The confirmation gates prevent wrong software names, versions, code selections, and business descriptions from reaching final documents.

faq.question: What final files can it produce?
faq.answer: It can produce application TXT output, code DOCX files, an operation manual DOCX, and a generation report.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill safely?
faq.answer: Claude Code can use the guided workflow, but users should review local setup scripts before running dependency installation commands.
